assumptions: The founder remains employed and can allocate 15-20 hours weekly while keeping all employer resources and data outside the business.
The public-default diagnostic can be delivered lawfully without supplier or verifier data, but its incremental decision value is not assumed.
No importer workflow, data access, payment, referral channel, renewal right, or permission to reuse cross-customer information is treated as secured until signed and observed.
The productized service can use contractors for methodology review and later analyst QA within the stated 45,000 PLN initial capital plan.
evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Multiple prepaid implementations with covered importers, evidence that the register changes a treasury or procurement decision or avoids costs exceeding its fee, conversion to prepaid quarterly retainers, at least two renewal cycles, observed sales-cycle and CAC data, delivery-hour records, fully loaded contribution margins, and signed workflow/data agreements. A direct comparison showing better decision value or lower total implementation burden than Carbon Glance and SAP-centered alternatives would materially improve confidence.

factors.name: Core insight
factors.rationale: The redesign more precisely targets a contractible treasury-control workflow and removes supplier evidence and accredited verification as launch-critical dependencies. It still addresses a workflow that specialist software and ERP incumbents can reproduce.

factors.name: Customer pain and willingness to pay
factors.rationale: Certificate budgeting and forecast variance are real financial problems, and adjacent buyer usage supports practical demand. No importer has paid for this specific exposure register, used it in treasury approval, documented value at least equal to the fee, or renewed quarterly; the €2,500 substitute constrains confidence in the proposed retainer.

factors.name: Business model and economics
factors.rationale: Prepaid implementation and quarterly work orders improve cash conversion, constrain initial scope, and make delivery economics observable before software investment. The model has lower scalability and margins than SaaS, while pricing, CAC, labor hours, support, security burden, contribution margin, renewal, and the 40-customer wealth scenario remain hypotheses.

factors.name: Market and beachhead
factors.rationale: Covered mid-market importers needing treasury visibility are a focused beachhead, and account selection can concentrate on material certificate exposure. The 50-tonne threshold narrows the pool, reachable account counts are unknown, and larger qualified importers may already be served by ERP, customs, or specialist platforms.

factors.name: Competitive position and domination potential
factors.rationale: An independent, fast, productized treasury-control service can occupy a narrower position than broad compliance software and may suit importers lacking major integrations. The position is nonexclusive and replaceable, with no signed workflow control, and neither templates nor variance reviews prevent copying or bundling.

factors.name: Expansion potential
factors.rationale: Importer-specific histories could lead to procurement analysis, carbon-cost controls, and eventual software automation. The service-led design creates learning but does not yet provide a strong distribution or data bridge into adjacencies, and permissioned reuse across customers is unproven.

factors.name: Defensibility and durability
factors.rationale: Recurring placement in treasury approval could create modest process switching costs and proprietary customer histories. The proposed agreement is unsigned, nonexclusive, consent-dependent, and replaceable; public regulatory inputs and optional supplier data offer little inherent moat.

factors.name: Strength of advantage
factors.rationale: The public-default fallback, defined scope, prepayment, and independent variance review provide a clearer and faster-to-launch offer than the original concept. There is no comparative evidence that it produces decisions valuable enough to justify materially more than low-cost software or functionality already bundled by SAP.

factors.name: Timing and momentum
factors.rationale: The definitive 2026 regime and changing certificate prices make cash planning timely, and recurring declarations and shipment changes support repeated reviews. Competitive urgency is equally high because specialist vendors and SAP are already responding.

factors.name: Distribution
factors.rationale: Direct account-based sales before relying on partners is testable and avoids assuming an unproven referral channel. Nevertheless, there is no qualified pipeline, conversion rate, observed CAC, signed referral source, or sales-cycle evidence, and enterprise trust and security reviews may be difficult within the founder's available time.

factors.name: Execution and risks
factors.rationale: The redesigned service is cheaper to launch, compatible with customer-uploaded files, narrower in scope, and more consistent with part-time validation and the founder's quantitative background. Material risks remain around importer cooperation, security, regulatory errors, founder sales capacity, analyst scaling, and ensuring the service is not represented as accredited verification.

highest_value_structural_change: Turn the proposed workflow position into observed control by signing several prepaid importer agreements that require the exposure register in quarterly treasury approval, then make renewal conditional on a measured value report and standardize delivery around the inputs and analyses that repeatedly influence decisions.
main_structural_strength: The redesign creates a capital-efficient, contractible and testable service wedge that can launch using importer-provided records and public defaults without making supplier or verifier cooperation a prerequisite.
primary_score_limiter: The redesigned workflow remains unsigned and replaceable, with no proof that its incremental decision value supports the proposed recurring price beside cheap specialist software and bundled ERP functionality.
strongest_disconfirming_evidence: A direct substitute offers overlapping projections and procurement functions for €2,500 per year, SAP is bundling cash-impact forecasting, and no importer has signed or paid for the proposed exposure-register workflow.
